verdict.rationale: Supabase is built on standard Postgres and is fully open-source/self-hostable (Docker Compose), and schema/migrations are captured as version-controlled SQL files, which together support an 'export and leave' story without vendor lock-in. However, there is no explicit documentation cited for a one-click data/backup export tool or bulk data-dump workflow beyond standard Postgres tooling implied by self-hosting and daily backups. Missing for 10: explicit data-export/backup-download docs, and independent confirmation that a full migration-out (data + auth + storage) is smooth in practice.
